entries.name: Riveted Ironstem
entries.notes: A SET IS ALL REFERENCE AND NO INVENTION. Every member names a CONCRETE base type, not just a role: ssot-sets.md 3.1 says membership is declared, not inferred, and 4 keys item_set_member on (set_id, container_id) with a NOT NULL frame. An earlier version of this exemplar showed members as {"role": ...} alone; all five set partitions copied it, and the result was thirty sets whose bonuses no player could ever earn while every reference in them resolved cleanly. A set is frame-neutral (3.7): a theme with frameAffinity "both" carries one row per (role, frame), and thresholds count distinct member ROLES, not rows. Member roles must be in the hybrid role core. A unique may never be a member (3.8).
